items.title: Bloomberg launches BQuant Assistant, an AI coding assistant for finance professionals
items.summary: Bloomberg introduced BQuant Assistant, a conversational AI assistant inside BQuant Desktop and BQuant Enterprise. It writes Python and BQL/PyBQL queries, debugs code and suggests visualizations. Queries can draw on more than 22,000 data fields. With user approval it can insert and run code in the BQuant sandbox. Generally available in BQuant Enterprise, limited beta in BQuant Desktop at the end of October.
items.why_it_matters: AI coding assistants are moving into the standard finance workflow, with human approval steps built in.

items.title: Meta's Muse personal AI agent launches in Singapore with Gmail, Grab and Shopee connectors
items.summary: Meta rolled out Muse, its personal AI agent, in Singapore. It connects to Gmail, Instagram and local services such as Grab and Shopee, and handles shopping, dining, travel planning and email tasks. Early partners reportedly include Agoda, Lazada, Shopee, Singapore Airlines and Trip.com. Coverage notes privacy concerns.
items.why_it_matters: A consumer agent acting across email and commerce services; a test of agent privacy and trust.

items.title: ChatGPT adds iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins and a 'Texting your dot' beta
items.summary: Per a search summary of OpenAI's ChatGPT release notes, iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins arrived on Oct 27 for all plans. On Oct 28 a beta let US Pro users text their always-on 'dot' agent. Custom GPTs are being retired in favour of plugins. Release notes page could not be opened; unconfirmed.

sources.name: OpenAI Help Center: ChatGPT release notes

items.why_it_matters: Apple users can connect mail and calendar to ChatGPT; custom GPT owners are affected.
